column7: security.require_mfa defaults to true (ADR-112): a FRESH install (no database, or no users) enforces it from its first start and records adr112.require_mfa.enforced so its later boots stay enforced (TestRecordADR112Markers_RequireMFARatchet). Only an upgraded deployment (users exist, no marker) that never set the key gets the grace period (not enforced, loud start-up warning) until the key is set explicitly; an explicit true is never graced and an undecidable database fails closed (enforced). The grace period has no compliance-based end condition yet (follow-up issue)
